description: Where each file of spec/ came from. Written by `npm run generate -- --spec <file>` or `-- --pending <file>`; do not edit it by hand. spec/pending-sandbox.json belongs to this repo: its sources are inside it.

source.note: The spec the developer portal publishes as v0.6.18: only the operations and events the portal shows. The sha256 is the one of the file the portal publishes in that version.

pending.note: The pending layer of the Node SDK at that commit, with edits made here on 2026-11-13 ahead of the SDK: the sources conversations-forms, communities-events and conversations-received say what portal v0.6.14 shows and what was checked again that day; whatsapp_form.completed types answers[].label as a string, and message.received accepts any string in message.type besides the known ones. Once the SDK's layer carries them, copy it again with --pending. What belongs to the sandbox goes in spec/pending-sandbox.json.
